name: SeaSubs
description: Find, load, or generate English Forced / Signs & Songs subtitles when the current release does not include them.
author: DefnoJae

fields.name: apiKey
fields.label: OpenSubtitles API key (optional)
fields.description: Optional source. SeaSubs can be installed and opened without configuring an OpenSubtitles account.

networkAccess.reasoning: Read English subtitle content from Vidnest's observed subtitle CDNs and AnimeTosho attachments, including compressed XZ files, with optional OpenSubtitles fallback.
